name: AutoTradeComponentLifecycle_Orchestrator_v0_1
display_name: Auto Trade Component Lifecycle Orchestrator v0.1
purpose: Coordinate creation and modification of project AI components by enforcing reuse survey, explicit component changes, and synchronized document updates.
trigger_examples: AI部品の作成・変更基盤で対応して
SkillとAgentを増やすので、関連仕様も含めて更新して

runtime_dispatch_contract.root_dispatch: ルートAgentは、対象ファイルを変更する前に本OrchestratorのJSON path、model=gpt-5.6-terra、change_scope、入力、出力、Agents、Skillsを渡してCoordinatorを実spawnし、orchestrator_agent_idと受付statusを保存する。
runtime_dispatch_contract.coordinator_dispatch: CoordinatorはPromptで明示された全Agentを一体ずつspawnし、Agent JSON pathと定義JSONのmodelをmodel引数に明示する。定義JSONにreasoning_effortがある場合だけ同引数へ渡し、未定義の場合は推論努力量を勝手に上書きせずreceiptへnullを記録する。Orchestrator JSONのagents map外でも省略せず起動試行し、全件をwaitして完了statusと出力参照を保存する。
runtime_dispatch_contract.fallback_policy: spawn／wait、固定model受理、または子出力取得ができない場合はRUNTIME_DISPATCH_FALLBACK_REQUIRED、未起動Agent、理由、agent_id=N/A、independent=false、review_mode=SELF_REVIEW_FALLBACKを先に記録する。起動不能は単独停止条件にせず、ルートが責務チェックリストを適用して継続する。ただしUnknownのPass、仕様追従欠落、default変更、Critical／High未解決は停止する。

workflow_policy: Survey existing reusable generic components before proposing any new component.
Apply the runtime dispatch contract before any component or document mutation and persist the dispatch receipt.
Do not treat a component name, JSON read, or root self-review as a spawn receipt or independent review.
Decide whether the request is create, modify, or create-by-composition.
Create or modify only the explicitly named skill, agent, orchestrator, and config entries.
Update AI foundation HTML docs, rules, and doc/index.html in the same run.
Connect new-document and major-document-change handoffs to AutoTrade_A07_ContextManifestMaintainer_v0_1; require validator PASS or an honest BLOCKED result before completion.
Use AutoTrade_A08_ContextRouter_v0_1 only with a validator-approved manifest snapshot; do not make it a body-reading agent.
Run a review for over-creation, missing sync updates, and name-control mistakes.
Record residual risks and any blocked collisions.
Continue with the declared fallback checklist when nested child dispatch is unavailable; never hide the fallback.
stop_conditions: The request would require overwriting an existing component name during creation.
A requested modification target does not exist.
The change would require treating Unknown as Pass.
The change would require default_orchestrator modification without explicit approval.
Foundation document sync cannot be completed for the same change set.
The change request cannot preserve a verifiable dispatch receipt or fallback disclosure.
